node_text: The starting point for GoF research does not need to be as dangerous due to the research itself.
quote: This assumes that WIV is able to find the virus, though in reality only a small fraction of wild viruses are ever sampled. Arguably the latter is the same factor of 1 /8 as fromZ, but I have weakened this to 1/2 as GoF research lowers how dangerous the starting point would need to be.
